archetypes.name: White-Blue Flyers
archetypes.plan: Build around Griffin Rider: Hold the ground with defensive creatures and interaction while a concentrated suite of flyers wins overhead.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Control
archetypes.plan: Build around Azure Mage: Trade one-for-one early, defend with high-toughness creatures, and win after card advantage exhausts the opponent.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Bloodthirst
archetypes.plan: Build around Bloodrage Vampire: Deal early damage reliably so bloodthirst creatures enter larger and keep the opponent on the defensive.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Bloodthirst
archetypes.plan: Build around Gorehorn Minotaurs: Guarantee early damage with cheap attackers or burn, then deploy oversized bloodthirst creatures on curve.

archetypes.name: Green-White Creatures
archetypes.plan: Build around Arachnus Spinner: Curve efficient creatures into larger bodies and use combat tricks to keep superior board presence.
